Slowly breathe in for a count of 5, then slowly exhale for a count of 5. Repeat this process for approximately 10 minute. It will help your stress levels and help regulate your heart rate!\\nseeker: Oh I didn't know that. No, I haven't tried that. Does it really work?\\nsupporter: I've been using it myself over the past 3 months and it most definitely helps!
